events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-139 commits on origin, mirror hold lines, and task card state
events.input: $ git remote -v | head -4; git fetch origin main -q 2>&1 | tail -2; for c in f5e9639 f63eb4a; do git log -1 --format='%h %s' $c 2>&1 | cut -c1-110; git merge-base --is-ancestor $c origin/main && echo "  on origin/main" || echo "  NOT on origin/main"; done; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E 'check-guides|probe-anonymity'; grep -n -i 'publish held\|mirror publish' workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -4; grep -n -i 'publish held' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch the mirror's s2 and s3 guide pages and look for the reconciled wording
events.input: $ cd /tmp && for g in s3-tantra-pro-flow s2-tantra-pro-funnel; do curl -sL "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/onboarding/guides/$g/?v=$(date +%s)" -o m-$g.html -w "$g %{http_code} %{size_download}\n"; done; grep -o -i 'attendance sync[^<]\{0,80\}' m-s3-tantra-pro-flow.html | head -2; grep -c -i 'twilio' m-s3-tantra-pro-flow.html; grep -o -i '4h \?30m\|T-15m\|T-24h' m-s3-tantra-pro-flow.html | sort | uniq -c; grep -o -i '600 \?ms[^<]\{0,60\}' m-s2-tantra-pro-funnel.html | head -2; grep -o -i 'double[- ]capture[^<]\{0,60\}' m-s2-tantra-pro-funnel.html | head -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm the decisions log section, mirror wording, and run check-guides
events.input: $ grep -n 'artifact read in full and reconciled' workshop-plan/coord/status/c.md | head -2; grep -c -E '^- (1[5-9]|2[0-8]),' workshop-plan/coord/status/c.md; grep -o -i '.\{60\}600 ms.\{20\}' app/src/content/guides/s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts | head -2; grep -o -i 'twice[^<]\{0,60\}\|already captured[^<]\{0,40\}\|guard[^<]\{0,60\}' /tmp/m-s2-tantra-pro-funnel.html | head -3; grep -o -i '.\{50\}twilio.\{50\}' /tmp/m-s3-tantra-pro-flow.html | head -2; cd app && (node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6)
